double cross: 1 upright x 2 short bars
upright through a small closed box (like 中)

long bar crossed by 3-4 short verticals
heavy bar with two forked (v-shaped) legs below
upright stroke with a flag/hook at the top (like 1 or 7)
ʒ with a vertical stroke through it
plain ʒ (often with a long lower curve)
large cursive R with long tail
small upright R, closed on the right
R rotated 90 degrees (seen only in letter 39)
looped R / &-like figure (first seen in letter 39)
small squiggle crossed by two bars (ꬲ-like)
heavy diagonal stroke ending in a loop at the right
wavy w with an extra loop
letter-f-like stroke with crossbar and long descender
long "mmm" with a large C-shaped flourish to the left
cross with flagged/slanted or looped upright
arrow-head on an upright with a base bar
small loop with a tail to the right (ɑ~)
z / ʐ, often with a loop at the top
cross with looped top and long descender (ꝗ-like)
tall looped l (first seen in letter 39)
